title.original: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
title.zh: ZeRO：面向万亿参数模型训练的内存优化
title.en: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models

inclusion_reason.zh: ZeRO 将优化器、梯度和参数冗余分片为可扩展的分布式训练机制，奠定 DeepSpeed 内存管理与后续大模型并行系统的基础。
inclusion_reason.en: ZeRO shards redundant optimizer, gradient, and parameter state as a scalable distributed-training mechanism, underpinning DeepSpeed memory management and later large-model parallel systems.

abstract.zh: ZeRO 通过消除数据并行和模型并行中的冗余状态，在保持较低通信量与较大计算粒度的同时扩大可训练模型规模。
abstract.en: ZeRO removes redundant state across data and model parallel training while retaining low communication volume and large computational granularity, expanding feasible model scale.

problem.zh: 传统数据并行在每张设备复制优化器、梯度和参数，模型并行又增加通信与开发复杂度，使百亿到万亿参数训练受显存限制。
problem.en: Traditional data parallelism replicates optimizer, gradient, and parameter state on every device, while model parallelism adds communication and development complexity, limiting very large models.

approach.zh: 系统按设备数分区优化器状态、梯度与参数，只在计算需要时通信或重构，从而让内存占用随并行规模下降。
approach.en: The system partitions optimizer state, gradients, and parameters across devices and communicates or reconstructs them only when needed, reducing per-device memory with scale.

system_design.zh: 分片状态由分布式运行时管理，反向阶段执行归约与分区，参数按计算阶段收集；通信计划保持大粒度算子并避免完整副本长期驻留。
system_design.en: A distributed runtime owns sharded state, performs reduce-and-partition during backpropagation, gathers parameters for computation, and avoids persistent full replicas while preserving coarse-grained operations.

key_results.zh: 官方摘要展示 ZeRO 在数百 GPU 上训练超百亿参数模型并显著扩大模型容量与可达到性能，同时分析其万亿参数扩展潜力。
key_results.en: The official abstract demonstrates training beyond one hundred billion parameters on hundreds of GPUs with large capacity and performance gains, and analyzes potential scaling past one trillion parameters.

limitations.zh: ZeRO 仍依赖高带宽集合通信，极端规模下参数收集和故障恢复成本突出；原始论文也早于当前 MoE、长上下文和异构集群需求。
limitations.en: ZeRO still relies on high-bandwidth collectives, with parameter gathering and recovery costs at extreme scale; the original work predates current MoE, long-context, and heterogeneous-cluster demands.

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
